title: CrowdStrike and Telkom Indonesia Enter into MoU to Advance AI-Powered Cybersecurity Transformation in Indonesia
summary: CrowdStrike and Telkom Indonesia sign an MoU to deliver AI-powered cybersecurity and managed services that stop breaches and secure AI across Indonesia.
body_markdown:
**AUSTIN, Texas and JAKARTA, Indonesia – August 28, 2026 –**[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/) (NASDAQ: CRWD) today announced that it has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with[PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk](https://www.telkom.co.id/) (Telkom), Indonesia’s leading technology and telecommunications services provider. The collaboration aims to transform Indonesian organizations’ cybersecurity through the delivery of AI-powered protection and managed security services that stop breaches and secure AI systems.


The collaboration demonstrates CrowdStrike and Telkom’s commitment to advancing cybersecurity modernization in Indonesia. This announcement is the first step in bringing together the AI-native[CrowdStrike Falcon](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/)[®](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/falcon-aidr-ai-detection-and-response/)[platform](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/) and CrowdStrike’s security services with Telkom’s local market experience, extensive Indonesian customer base of public and private sector organizations, and technology infrastructure. Together, CrowdStrike and Telkom aim to strengthen security capabilities, explore opportunities for joint innovation, provide CrowdStrike-powered security offerings, and develop joint go-to-market initiatives. Through the collaboration, Telkom also plans to standardize its own cyber defenses on the Falcon platform.


As AI transforms how regional organizations do business, CrowdStrike and Telkom are exploring the development of managed security services to secure enterprise AI adoption. This includes driving adoption of[Falcon AI Detection and Response (AIDR)](https://www.crowdstrike.com/en-us/platform/falcon-aidr-ai-detection-and-response/) , which delivers complete visibility and runtime enforcement from the endpoint, where AI executes – and across the enterprise. To achieve this objective, both companies intend to establish a joint team focused on co-developing solution offerings to secure AI agents, models, and systems – so organizations can adopt AI at scale, with confidence.


"AI is transforming how organizations operate and how they run cybersecurity programs," said Jonathon Dixon, vice president and managing director, Japan and Asia Pacific at CrowdStrike. "Telkom shares our commitment to securing Indonesia's AI future, bringing AI-powered protection and security for AI to the organizations powering the region's digital transformation."


“Through our collaboration with CrowdStrike we aim to help organizations enhance their cybersecurity with proven security capabilities that address the speed and sophistication of today’s attacks,” said Seno Soemadji, Director of Strategic Business Development & Portfolio at Telkom Indonesia. “Importantly, by working closely together with CrowdStrike, the expertise of our security teams and analysts will also be strengthened, enhancing our ability to help our broad customer base detect and respond to attacks. This collaboration will explore long-term cyber resilience, including hardening regional organizations against threats advanced by emerging technologies such as AI and quantum computing.”


**About CrowdStrike**
[CrowdStrike](https://www.crowdstrike.com/) (NASDAQ: CRWD), a global cybersecurity leader, has redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced cloud-native platform for protecting critical areas of enterprise risk – endpoints and cloud workloads, identity and data.


Powered by the CrowdStrike Security Cloud and world-class AI, the CrowdStrike Falcon® platform leverages real-time indicators of attack, threat intelligence, evolving adversary tradecraft, and enriched telemetry from across the enterprise to deliver hyper-accurate detections, automated protection and remediation, elite threat hunting, and prioritized observability of vulnerabilities.


Purpose-built in the cloud with a single lightweight-agent architecture, the Falcon platform delivers rapid and scalable deployment, superior protection and performance, reduced complexity, and immediate time-to-value.
